# Where activity files and media may live.
#
# .github/scripts/check-activity-files.sh fails CI when a guarded file is in the
# tree, or is added by any commit of a pull request, outside these paths.
# Guarded files are activity files (.fit .gpx .tcx .kml .kmz, also gzipped, and
# .zip archives, which bulk import accepts), images and videos. The full list of
# extensions is GUARDED_EXTENSIONS in the script.
#
# Why: the repository must never again publish a real recorded run or media of
# its route (ADR-0012). Only synthetic fixtures and docs images belong here.
#
# One shell glob per line, matched against the repository-relative path.
# `*` also matches `/`, so `dir/*` covers everything below dir/.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# Activity-file test fixtures (synthetic only, see ADR-0012).
src/test/resources/runs/*

# Documentation images. Strip EXIF/GPS metadata before committing one
# (docs/release/going-public-checklist.md shows how to check).
docs/images/*
docs/*/images/*
